title: A first Sync from live after an import compares with the import's fingerprint, never reads Tracy's own files, skips file steps that change nothing, and a visit to the copy during a sync is not the copy changing
expect: S1: every test passes; the engine's own files under administrator/components/com_claudecowork are neither read nor hashed nor deleted; changed files are read a few at a time; the import's fingerprint is taken with live-pull's own skip list and none from an older engine; a live read whose files are the base's answers with the copy's own tree

selectors.host: live-pull.mjs isTracyPath READ_CONCURRENCY, export.ts takeFingerprint, webroot-sync.sh base-fingerprint.json db_checksums theirs_of_last_merge, live_sync.py merge_files tree_of IdMap.catalogue numbers_of, webroot-git.sh restore_reset count

fence: A sync never reads files the merge always keeps from the copy, and a person viewing the copy never fails a sync
